country.evidence_quote: Abbazia di Novacella is a functioning Augustinian monastery that traces its winemaking activities back to the 12th century. All that experience has paid off, as the Novacella wines are reliably delicious. The kerner grape, a Germanic cross that is right at home in Tyrolean Italy, offers an earthy citrus richness that is balanced and refreshing. (Abbazia di Novacella U.S.A., Sausalito, Calif.)
